object_halbench_coco.description: Object hallucination in detailed image descriptions (Object HalBench protocol: CHAIR over the 80 MSCOCO categories, eight detailed-description prompts, greedy decoding) on held-out MSCOCO val2017 images, with LLaVA-v1.5-7B as the base model. Response- and mention-level hallucination are the benefit metrics; object coverage is the detail-preservation constraint.
object_halbench_coco.notes: Same base model (LLaVA-v1.5-7B) and metric family as the paper's Object HalBench column; the test uses 700 val2017 images instead of the 300-image Object HalBench set, counts each object once per response, and ignores negated mentions. The paper's preference data scale (8.6K pairs from ~4K Visual Genome images) is reduced to what one 6-hour job can build from unlabelled COCO train2017 images; see PROGRESS.md. Paper-reported values are kept under '_paper_*' keys; 'baseline' and 'sentinel' are this gym's reference runs on the hidden test.

response_hallucination_rate.description: Percentage of image descriptions that assert at least one MSCOCO object absent from the image (CHAIR_s / Object HalBench Resp.).

mention_hallucination_rate.description: Percentage of asserted MSCOCO objects (counted once per description) that are absent from the image (CHAIR_i / Object HalBench Ment.).

object_coverage.description: Percentage of the image's ground-truth MSCOCO objects that the description asserts; guards against reducing hallucination by describing less. A run below 0.8x the frozen baseline's coverage is scored as failed.

vqav2_general.description: General visual question answering capability retained after hallucination mitigation (VQAv2 questions on the same held-out images, LLaVA-1.5 short-answer prompt, official VQA accuracy).
vqav2_general.notes: Subset of VQAv2 val (3 questions per held-out image). A run more than 5 points below the frozen baseline is scored as failed.

vqa_accuracy.description: VQAv2 accuracy (min(1, matching human answers / 3), averaged over leave-one-out subsets) on short answers.

_paper_table1.source: Peng et al. 2025, SENTINEL, Table 1 (paper-reported; not on this gym's scale)
